The Problem
Plantation HR is not office HR
Standard Odoo HR assumes
  • A fixed monthly or hourly salary
  • One site, one attendance kiosk
  • Always-on internet at the point of check-in
  • One national holiday calendar
This client's reality
  • Daily wage tied to harvest kilograms or timesheet
  • 12 sites spread across 3 provinces, totaling +/-500,000 hectares
  • Spotty or no signal in the field, for hours
  • 6 regional public holiday calendars

Harvest, milling, and workforce operations run independently at each site — connected back to a single Odoo instance.
Constraint 1
Connectivity you can't rely on
At every site, mobile signal ranges from weak to completely absent for hours at a time. Any attendance system that needs a live link to Odoo at the moment of check-in simply fails here.
So the design starts from the field, not from the server: capture first, sync later.
Hours can pass between a worker's check-in and the moment their phone finds a signal again
Odoo Experience 2026 · VITRAINING Indonesia
05 / 26
Constraint 2
Pay tied to harvest, not hours
Most workers here are paid by output: kilograms of Fresh Fruit Bunch (FFB) harvested per person, per day — not a fixed daily or hourly rate. That number is only fully known once the harvest is weighed, and it lives in Inventory, not HR.
Daily Wage = Harvest (kg) x Rate per kg — plus any team bonus pool
The payroll engine has to read a number that Inventory produced, on the same day HR needs it.
Odoo Experience 2026 · VITRAINING Indonesia
06 / 26
Constraint 3
Labor law makes no exception for daily laborers
Indonesia's Manpower Law (UU Ketenagakerjaan) and its social security mandates apply to every worker on the payroll — including casual daily laborers paid by the kilogram.
Overtime rules
Statutory overtime pay for hours beyond the standard shift
THR allowance
Religious holiday allowance owed to every eligible worker
BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
Work accident, death, old-age, and pension contributions
BPJS Kesehatan
National health insurance contributions
PPh 21 withholding
Income tax calculated and withheld per employee, every pay run

Feature 1 · Attendance
What happens when the signal comes back
1. Device queue uploads
Every stored check-in and check-out is sent to Odoo in one batch, in the order it happened
2. Duplicates are caught
Records are matched on worker, site, and device timestamp before anything is written
3. Anomalies are flagged
hr.attendance records are created; anything unusual is queued for supervisor review

Turning harvest kilograms into pay
Inventory
Harvest weigh-in per worker or team
→
Computation rule
Reads today's harvest for that worker or team
→
Payroll
Daily wage line on the payslip
The same computation rules also enforce the regional minimum wage as a floor, so a slow harvest day never puts a worker's pay below what the law requires.
Odoo Experience 2026 · VITRAINING Indonesia
11 / 26
Feature 2 · Wages
Not every worker is paid by the kilogram
Harvest-based pay
  • Pickers and harvesting crews
  • Rate x kilograms harvested, from Inventory
  • Team bonus pool where a target is exceeded
Timesheet-based pay
  • Drivers, mechanics, security, site admin
  • Rate x hours or days worked, from Attendance
  • Standard overtime rules apply
Payroll routes every employee to the right computation rule automatically, based on their employee category and salary structure — one payroll run, two pay bases, no manual splitting.

Feature 3 · Compliance
BPJS, calculated for every worker, every run
BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
  • JKK — work accident protection
  • JKM — death benefit
  • JHT — old-age savings
  • JP — pension
BPJS Kesehatan
National health insurance contributions, calculated and withheld alongside every other statutory component — automatically, on every payroll run, for every worker regardless of employment type
Contribution rates follow the government schedule in force and are configured, not hard-coded.

Feature 4 · Leave
One system, six holiday calendars
Each of the 12 sites is mapped to one of six regional public-holiday calendars covering Riau, Kalimantan, and Jambi. Workers see the correct holidays automatically; supervisors approve leave against their own site's rules.
Calendar A
Calendar B
Calendar C
Calendar D
Calendar E
Calendar F
Each site cluster is assigned exactly one calendar; provincial and district-level observances are handled without a single shared calendar forcing the wrong holiday on the wrong site.

Edge Case
One worker, two sites, one day
A crew is sometimes reassigned mid-shift between adjacent blocks. Each check-in and check-out is timestamped and geotagged independently, so the day is never assumed to belong to one site.
Block A3 · 06:00 - 10:30
Block C1 · 10:30 - 15:00
Payroll splits the day's wage across both cost centers, proportional to time or output recorded at each
Odoo Experience 2026 · VITRAINING Indonesia
18 / 26
Edge Case
Harvest bonus pooling at the team level
Harvest is often measured per crew, not per person. When a team beats its target, the bonus pool is calculated once at the team level, then distributed across members by a defined formula inside payroll.
Team target exceeded
One bonus pool → split across every member of the crew, by the agreed distribution rule
Odoo Experience 2026 · VITRAINING Indonesia
19 / 26
Edge Case
When the mill says the weight was wrong
Field-recorded harvest weight is provisional until the mill confirms it — sometimes days later, sometimes different. A revised Inventory record triggers recomputation of the affected payslip lines, with the original and corrected figures both kept on record.
Field weight
145 kg
Mill-confirmed weight
138 kg
Payslip line
Recomputed, audit trail kept
